state_meaning: AI-drafted candidate; no person has reviewed it.
text: The paper reports that when critic models are stronger than the supervised model, direct critique gives better results than letting the supervised model first perform higher-order self-critique, and concludes that self-critique from weaker models may not be effective and can even mislead stronger critics.
title: AI-AI: direct critique beats recursive self-critique when the critic is stronger
